refs.note: The operator's own site, read in a search result, so nothing from it is quoted as survey. AN EARLIER VERSION OF THIS NOTE ATTRIBUTED A SENTENCE TO IT THAT IS NOT ON IT -- it said the site describes the basse-cour as holding « une ferme, un colombier et une grange, lesquels forment un très bel ensemble architectural, représentatif des constructions régionales à pan de bois ». Re-read 5 Sep 2026: that sentence is printed word for word by jardinez.com, and Ouest-France prints a variant of it (« formant un très bel ensemble architectural ») quoting the château's own director; no page on chateaudecrevecoeur.com read here carries it. What the operator's own texts say -- its description page and its 2021 and 2026 brochures -- is « La basse-cour se compose d'une ferme, d'un colombier et d'une grange des XVème et XVIème siècles auxquels s'ajoute la chapelle du XIIème siècle », and that description page dates the ferme and the colombier to the 15th century and the grange to the 16th, against this record's own `dates.built`. A sentence a search returns beside a URL is not that URL's sentence, which is why a ref whose `via` is tavily-search may not carry a quotation.

rights_evidence: (c) Monuments historiques. Cette notice reprend intégralement les termes de l’arrêté de protection au titre des Monuments historiques. Elle répond à l’obligation réglementaire du ministère de la Culture d’établir la liste générale des immeubles protégés (art. R. 621-80 du Code du patrimoine). Elle est donc opposable et fait foi juridiquement. Aucune copie numérique ou papier ne sera fournie par courrier ni courriel. Le dossier de protection complet et l’arrêté sont consultables uniquement sur place, dans la salle de lecture de la Médiathèque du patrimoine et de la photographie (MPP), à Charenton-le-Pont (Val-de-Marne).
note: Tranche 3, French manoir and provincial farmhouse cluster, 5 Sep 2026. New exemplar. Carried for the BASSE-COUR rather than for the castle: the ferme, the square colombier and the grange are the 15th-century timber-framed working ensemble this node describes, standing where the node says such buildings stand -- loose in an enclosure, nothing attached to anything. Quotes are transcribed from a tavily-extract of the POP notice read 5 Sep 2026. The extract prints each notice field as a label on one line and its value on another; runs of whitespace are normalised to one space in the quote text and nothing else is changed. Where the tier dropped a circumflex the loss is transcribed as returned. The Mérimée notice carries no Description historique, so the survey block is protection and designation only; the description of the timber buildings sits in the refs' notes, where it is unchecked prose.
